messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT detected — sustained token QPS spike for org 'nova-retail'. error budget approaching. paging maya (oncall) :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): on it. what's the impact, any 5xx increases?

lina (support): customer reports timeouts in storefront search. CX thread link: https://redwood/support/threads/NR-462 (internal) :eyes:

kevin (infra): metrics: qps jumped from ~40/s to 420/s in last 10m, p95 latency up 3x, small bump in 503s. Likely a client-side retry storm + long prompt churn. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz/nova-retail

jonah (prod): Nova-retail is on Dedicated reserved but burst policy allowed extra capacity and exhausted their burst tokens. We can apply a short RL override to protect SLOs for other orgs.

maya (oncall): agree. propose surgical throttle: cap nova-retail to 90rps per-org for 20m, disable streaming for their endpoints to reduce KV pressure, and enable fallback model variant (gpt-lite) for non-critical routes.

ops-lead: +1 — need command to apply now and audit log entry. keep duration small, communicate to support.

kevin (infra): running admin CLI now:
```
# apply temporary rate-limit override
redwood-admin override create --org nova-retail --type qps --limit 90 --duration 20m --reason "emergency spike mitigation" --actor maya
```

sre-bot: override created id=ovr-20260311-88fa, applied by maya, expires in 20m.

kevin (infra): also toggled streaming off for nova-retail (non-critical routes) with command:
```
redwood-admin org update nova-retail --feature streaming:false --actor kevin
```

sre-bot: feature flag updated.

lina (support): sending customer note into CX thread: "We've applied a temporary safety throttle to stabilize latency; your requests will be queued at reduced QPS for ~20 minutes while we investigate. We'll update you if more action is needed."

jonah (prod): seeing immediate drop in cross-tenant tail latency and error rate normalized within 90s. nova-retail traffic now ~85rps. p95 down to expected range.

maya (oncall): good. I'll stay on this for the next 25 mins. if metrics look stable, we'll remove the override early and document in postmortem. can someone capture timeline + commands?

kevin (infra): logging steps to incident tracker and saving override id. command history attached to ticket INC-2026-339.

ops-lead: reminder — next steps: 1) support follow-up to customer 2) root-cause follow-up (client retry pattern) 3) consider auto-scaling policy tweak to avoid exhausting bursts 4) postmortem owner: jonah.

maya (oncall): handing off to jonah for post-incident work. leaving thread but available if rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

jonah (prod): taking postmortem. will follow up with timeline, mitigations, and recommended infra changes. tagging this for next oncall review.

sre-bot: override ovr-20260311-88fa expired (or removed early) — removed at 3214510500 by maya. Incident closed for active mitigation; follow-ups assigned.
